desc: Relaxed restaurant offering pizza, shared plates & burgers, plus cocktails & shisha.
addr: 2ND AND 3RD FLOOR, 74, Jyoti Nivas College Rd, 5th Block, Koramangala, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560095, India

rev.t: This place serves tasty vegetarian food. It has a lovely ambience and unique seating options. They also provide different decorations for occasions. It's a pure veg restaurant. It serves hookah so for non smokers it's a big time issue. Loved each item ordered except for burger which was avoidable. Had been here about 3 years back.
It a great for hookah in Koramangala. They serve good vegetarian food too. Do try their mock tips which are quite refreshing. …

Sometimes all you need is good food to lift up your mood.
And good North Indian food is anytime is my comfort food to go for. …
